reviewed..github/workflows/mcp.yml: The gateway and package-core CI jobs: each job's length is its ci-scope inputs and the comments recording why each path is watched, and the jobs share one trigger block whose rules check-workflow-triggers.mjs enforces, so a second file would duplicate that block for no gain.
reviewed..github/workflows/ci.yml: The pull-request entry workflow: the reusable workflow's inputs and its change-filters are one YAML block that must stay in this file, and most of its length is the convex filter's list of gateway files Convex reaches (scripts/convex-gateway-reads.mjs --filter), which check-ci-path-gates.mjs holds to that derivation.
reviewed.apps/mobile/features/console/settings/se: The settings catalogue: every section with its label, search words and flags in one list the sidebar, the search box and the tests read, kept whole so one file says what settings exist; most of its length is the comment on each row recording why it is where it is.
reviewed.apps/mobile/features/design/tokens/color: The app's colour tokens as one table: each theme's values sit side by side, and the contrast and palette tests read the whole table, so splitting it would scatter one theme across files.
reviewed.apps/mcp/test/browser/verifyEditor.mjs: One browser harness: every scenario shares the same worker, control plane, static build and two signed-in pages it boots once; splitting it would boot that stack per file.
reviewed.apps/mobile/features/console/collaborati: One class, DurableCollaborationController: the device record, the flush queue, remote reads, recovery replacement and generation adoption all mutate the same private record and Yjs document.

reviewed.apps/convex/__tests__/structure/httpRout: The gateway's HTTP routes, plus the route-factory constants and helpers only these checks use.

reviewed.apps/convex/http.ts: The HTTP router: every route declaration, its factory and registration order, plus the unauthenticated share-preview and ingest routes that httpRoutes.test.ts and ingestionGateway tests read field by field from this file; handler bodies live in lib/gatewayRoutes.
